Your medication match
Found's clinicians match your hormone formula to your specific symptom pattern, lifestyle, and health history.
💊
Bioidentical Estradiol
Chemically identical to the estrogen your body produces naturally. Available as a gel, patch, or pill based on your preference.
🌿
Micronized Progesterone
Protects the uterine lining and supports deeper, more restorative sleep. Often described as "nature's tranquilizer."
🔬
Ongoing monitoring
Your clinician adjusts your formula based on quarterly lab work and how you're feeling. Your care evolves with you.
Why bioidentical HRT?

Bioidentical hormones are derived from plant sources and are structurally identical to your body's own hormones — designed to work with your physiology, not against it.

FAQ

How do I know if hormone therapy (HRT) is right for me? ∨

Maybe your periods have started showing up differently. Maybe you're waking up at 3 a.m., overheated, and can't fall back asleep. Maybe you feel foggier, more irritable, or less like yourself than you used to, and you can't quite pin down why. These are common signs that your hormones are shifting toward perimenopause or menopause. If they're affecting your sleep, mood, or day to day life, that's usually the moment it's worth asking about HRT.

You've already done part of the work. The questions you just answered to get matched with a medication were written by the same clinicians who will review your case and make the final prescription decision.

What is the difference between the medications? ∨

There are a few tools, not one HRT, and your plan is built around what your body needs, whether you're in perimenopause or menopause. We offer the following medications, and built your recommendation based on your answers.

  • ·Topical estrogen cream is absorbed through the skin, treats body-wide symptoms like hot flashes and night sweats.
  • ·Vaginal estrogen cream targets dryness and urinary symptoms directly, with minimal absorption into the bloodstream.
  • ·If you have a uterus and use topical estrogen, progesterone protects your uterine lining, chosen and dosed based on your history. It can also help ease hormone-related sleep and mood issues.
Will I have to stay on HRT forever? ∨

There's no mandatory stop age. You don't have to come off HRT at 60, 65, or any birthday. You might use it for a few years, or you might continue longer because your symptoms return without it or the benefits still outweigh the risks for you. Starting closer to menopause, generally within about 10 years of it and before age 60, is linked to the greatest benefit and lowest risk. If you're in perimenopause, your symptoms might call for starting sooner. You and your care team revisit the decision together on a schedule that works for you.

Why should I buy from Found? ∨

Found treats the whole picture, not just one symptom. Weight, hormones, and metabolism live with one clinician, because your body doesn't separate them either. Your care is prescribed and managed by licensed clinicians with specialized training in metabolic and hormonal health. If you're also managing weight, hormonal shifts can drive plateaus and symptoms a GLP-1 alone can't reach, so pairing it with HRT addresses the fuller picture. And getting care is straightforward: insurance when we can, clear cash-pay pricing when we can't.

Does hormone therapy cause breast cancer? ∨

The 2002 Women's Health Initiative study is behind most of the fear around HRT and breast cancer, but it used older hormones, started them outside the ideal window, and has since been reanalyzed, so its results don't reflect today's approach.

Breast cancer risk depends on things like your age, genetics, and breast density, not hormone therapy alone. That's why your care team screens your personal and family history upfront, chooses the type and dose of hormones based on what's safest for you, and recommends you always stay up to date with mammograms.
